## Upgrading from v0.6.0

Nothing to do.

## Highlights

- Dependencies updated. 66 packages moved within the ranges the manifest
  already declared, and two moved past them: `itertools` 0.14 to 0.15 and
  `num-derive` 0.4 to 0.5. Neither needed a line of code changed.

  Two more could not. `ndarray` 0.17 is out, but `lapjv` — which takes the cost
  matrix for the Hungarian aggregator — requires `ndarray ^0.16` and has had no
  release since September 2025, so the two meet at a type mismatch that nothing
  here can resolve. `sha2` 0.11 changes `Output` so that `format!("{:x}")` no
  longer applies; the hash is a filename suffix, so the fix would be a new
  dependency or hand-written hex for no gain, and 0.10.9 is maintained.

  `rmcp` went 3.2.0 to 3.5.0 inside its existing range, which is the MCP server
  itself. A compiling server is not a working one, so `verify_mcp.sh` spoke the
  protocol to the built binary and read five tools back.
